title: AI Spending Fears Hammer Big Tech Stocks
summary: Disappointing Big Tech earnings are intensifying investor concerns over whether massive AI spending will generate sufficient returns, according to Bloomberg's technology editor.

title: Crypto exchanges rush to tighten security after $6.3bn Binance heist
summary: Crypto exchanges are tightening security, placing additional alerts and restrictions on fund movements, after the $6.3bn Binance heist.

title: SoftBank-Backed OPay Halts IPO to Respond to Regulatory Inquiry
summary: SoftBank-backed OPay, a Nigeria-focused payments platform, halted its NYSE IPO, which was due to start trading Friday, citing a regulatory inquiry.

title: OpenAI’s Altman Meets Samsung Executives as Chip Crunch Deepens
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman met Samsung's top executives in South Korea to deepen cooperation on memory chips and AI infrastructure as global shortages intensify.

title: Is this the first clear evidence of AI’s impact on the labour market?
summary: The FT examines whether tech-sector data offers the first clear evidence of AI's labour-market impact: productivity is up and employment down in tech, while the picture elsewhere is muddier.

title: OpenAI Funding Target Cut by $10 Billion as AI Slumps, FT Says
summary: OpenAI has cut its fundraising target by $10 billion as an AI stock selloff and Anthropic's impending public listing complicate efforts to secure investor commitments, per the FT. The move underscores growing investor caution around frontier-AI valuations.

title: La economía toma el ‘carril de alta velocidad’
summary: Columna de opinión sobre la reactivación de la economía mexicana en el tercer trimestre: la estimación oportuna del PIB muestra un repunte consolidado en julio-septiembre de 2026.

title: Wall Street despide octubre con números rojos; BMV gana 8.67% mensual
summary: Wall Street cerró octubre en rojo tras una venta masiva liderada por tecnológicas, mientras que la BMV ganó 8.67% en el mes.

title: ¿Conoces realmente a quienes diriges?
summary: Columna de opinión sobre la importancia de que los líderes conozcan a cada integrante de su equipo y adapten su trato a cada uno, con una analogía de crianza.

title: KBRA ratificó la calificación crediticia de México en BBB: Hacienda
summary: Hacienda informó que KBRA ratificó la calificación soberana de México en BBB con perspectiva estable, destacando la solidez de los fundamentos del país.

title: NYSE Owner Plans Hyperliquid Perpetuals Market in US
summary: Intercontinental Exchange is teaming with Trade.xyz, a market operator behind Hyperliquid, to bring perpetual futures into US regulated markets.

title: Crypto Hack Reignites Regulatory Debate
summary: A $6 billion crypto hack has put digital-asset security back in focus; ex-CFTC chair Chris Giancarlo argues it exposed weaknesses at one firm, not a failure of blockchain itself.

title: Baseten to Raise Funding That Would Double Value to $30 Billion
summary: AI startup Baseten is set to raise new funding that would more than double its valuation to about $30 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Meta’s Rating Outlook Cut to Negative by S&P on AI Spending
summary: S&P Global Ratings cut Meta's rating outlook to negative, an early step toward a possible downgrade within two years, citing elevated AI-related spending pressuring its balance sheet.

title: Las claves económicas de la semana (26 al 30 de octubre): Del PIB de México y Estados Unidos
summary: Resumen económico semanal, encabezado por la estimación oportuna del PIB de México al tercer trimestre y por los datos de Estados Unidos que concentraron la atención de los inversionistas.

title: The Future of Financial Advice: Masters in Business with Rich Steinmeier
summary: LPL Financial CEO Rich Steinmeier discusses the firm's $2.7 billion Commonwealth acquisition and the evolving relationship between AI and financial advice.

title: Hacienda descarta volver a utilizar P-Caps para apoyar finanzas de Pemex
summary: El secretario de Hacienda, Édgar Amador, dijo que no prevén volver a usar las Notas Precapitalizadas (P-Caps) para apoyar las finanzas de Pemex.

title: GAFI acepta reporte de la evaluación antilavado de México, publicará resultados en diciembre
summary: El GAFI adoptó los reportes de evaluación mutua de México y Estados Unidos en su plenaria de París; los resultados se publicarán en diciembre. El resultado es relevante para la posición de México en materia antilavado.

title: OpenAI, Google y Microsoft prometen a medios una solución que evita que la IA extraiga contenidos
summary: OpenAI, Google and Microsoft pledged to give publishers a way to prevent their content from being scraped to train AI models, amid ongoing legal disputes.

title: Nasdaq 100 roza la corrección tras desplome de Intel, hackeo a Binance golpea al bitcoin y el oro se hunde
summary: Wall Street cerró con fuertes pérdidas ante una nueva ola de ventas de acciones tecnológicas que profundizó las dudas sobre la rentabilidad de las inversiones en IA. El bitcoin también retrocedió tras el hackeo a Binance.

title: Big Tech Holds $3 Trillion in Spending Commitments for AI Boom
summary: The five largest data-center players have committed more than $3 trillion in spending over coming years, pointing to massive continued AI infrastructure investment.

title: Anthropic may not secure investment-grade rating after IPO, Blackstone says
summary: Blackstone says Anthropic may not receive an investment-grade rating after its IPO, expecting a 'high' junk rating, a shift from prior guidance. The note signals how credit markets are assessing frontier AI labs' heavy capital needs.

title: El peso se debilita otra vez: el precio de dólar roza los MXN$19
summary: El dólar se acerca a MXN$19 y el peso cotizó en MXN$18,92 en el mercado spot, ante la incertidumbre sobre el diferencial de tasas entre México y otras economías.

title: AI Policy Risks Loom Over Stock, Bond Traders Ahead of Midterms
summary: Wall Street expects Democrats to win at least one chamber in Tuesday's midterms, and traders are wary of volatility around AI oversight, defense spending and crypto policy.

title: World Cities Day 2026 Explores "Regenerating the City: Adequate Housing for All"
summary: World Cities Day 2026, observed October 31 in Fuzhou, focuses on 'Regenerating the City: Adequate Housing for All', exploring how urban regeneration can improve access to adequate housing.

title: Google’s $500bn bloodbath reflects the danger it faces from AI
summary: The Economist links Google's roughly $500bn market-value loss to the threat AI poses to its core search business, as rivals gain ground while its search engine sputters.
